in_sanskrit.name: Pugal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fortress, Stronghold
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pugal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who holds the fort, one who is a fortress or stronghold. Derived from the Tamil word 'pugazh' meaning fort, and 'al' meaning one who holds. The name is often given to children born into royal families or those who are expected to lead.
